messages.subject: tikz and axes labels
parts:
Hi,

Perhaps there is a better place to post this question, but I suspect some of you know the answer.

When I use knitr+tikz+ggplot2 the x axis and y axis labels, as well as the main title overlap the graphics area of the figure. Sometimes it doesn't overlap, but it is way to close (see attached pdf - hope it comes through).

Any idea how to fix it?

Thanks,
Guy

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] tikz and axes labels
parts:
This is a good place to post questions.

The margin between text labels and the plot region may depend on the
device size (chunk options fig.width and fig.height); you can try to
use larger or smaller sizes and see if they make any difference. It is
probably better to post the source code of a minimal example as well.

Regards,
Yihui
